name: Mint Meadow (replaces the Golden Hour Pastel grade values for preset B)
apply: after tone mapping + OutputPass, as a final LUT pass (THREE LUTPass with LUTCubeLoader or LUTImageLoader). LUT intensity 1.0; 0.0 = old look for A/B.

vignette.why: lighter, green-grey not rose; keeps the frame open on phones

bloomThreshold.why: stops pale meadow ground blooming out

tiers.low: no post pass: bake the look into lights/fog only (hemiSky, hemiGround, fogColour, sun #fff4e0 ×0.95); skip the LUT and vignette
tiers.med: LUT pass only (one fullscreen draw, 32³ 3D texture); vignette folded into the same shader

nightLevels: moon_meadow, owl_wood, night_market: keep their current night palette; use LUT intensity 0.5 so greens still read mint

presetB_dropIn.where: source/src/preset-B.js grade block (line ~45) and quality.low.bakeGrade (line ~57); look.js reads these keys already
